# `try_url_decode`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

This is a special version of `url_decode` that performs the same operation, but returns a NULL value instead of raising an error if the decoding cannot be performed.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_url_decode(str)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `url_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_url_decode, example 1
> SELECT try_url_decode('https%3A%2F%2Fspark.apache.org');
https://spark.apache.org
```
